{{Hatnote|This page documents a constructed card pool. Official tournament documents remain authoritative.}}
'''Premiere &ndash; Jabba's Palace''' (display name '''Premiere - Jabba's Palace'''; GEMP code <code>premiere_jp</code>) is a constructed environment whose legal pool is the printed Decipher sets from [[Premiere]] through [[Jabba's Palace]].

Decipher Deck Designs from 1998 (April through October, after Jabba's Palace and before [[Special Edition]]) used this pool. On [https://play.swccg.com/ play.swccg.com] the same environment is <code>premiere_jp</code> (set ids 1&ndash;6 plus premium ids 101&ndash;107).
